# InkBloom Reader

InkBloom Reader is a free, fully offline ebook reader with no account, no cloud, no purchases and no ads in the app.
It opens EPUB, PDF, TXT, Markdown, HTML, FB2, RTF, DOCX and ODT books, remembers the exact page and line,
and runs on Android, Windows, Linux and any modern web browser. A whole library moves to a new device with one
offline .inkbloom file, no account needed.

## Key facts
- No account, no sign-in, no cloud, no tracking in the app, no purchases, no ads in the app.
- 12 reading themes plus auto-night; 5 highlight colours with notes; bookmarks; in-book search; read-aloud.
- Reading stats, goals and streaks stored only on the device; shelves, favourites and tags.
- Offline dictionary with 152 built-in words plus user definitions; 77 interface languages with RTL support.
- MOBI and AZW are not supported; convert to EPUB first. Scanned, image-only PDFs are rejected.
- The .inkbloom transfer file is a plain ZIP, not encrypted; it is moved by the user, never uploaded.
- Maker: Wajiha Noreen — https://www.wajiha.fun/ — Contact: games@wajiha.fun
